method.exact_map_collision_not_recomputed_again: Display may be newer than each plan; use the worker native current-revision invalid-edge metric, plus independent exact parent/XYZ structural audit.
method.status_fraction: Fraction of five-second state samples, not continuous-time duty cycle.
method.distance: Differences of runtime per-tick measured cumulative distance counters.
method.z_range: Range of actual measured positions at sampled instants; full-run extrema can exceed it.
method.recovery_counts: Sum of per-response counters on distinct sampled path IDs; lower bound because unsampled responses are omitted. Clear is physical map evidence, not independently attributed to people versus other objects.
method.goal_retention: Only observed plan goal_revision transitions count. No transition means unverified in this window.

go2_01.native_collision_check_evidence: worker full current-map+dynamic checker invalid_tree_edges metric; independent audit checks parent topology only

uav_01.native_collision_check_evidence: worker full current-map+dynamic checker invalid_tree_edges metric; independent audit checks parent topology only

supplemental_run_event_evidence.scope: Existing same-epoch init/set_goal events up to the end of the 90-second window; may predate the sampled window.
supplemental_run_event_evidence.restoration_event_limit: planner_result events do not contain per-update restored_nodes/historical_edges_restored; no retrospective total or human-specific attribution is possible.
